data.source: alpaca crypto daily v1beta3 (UTC days) via scanner_crypto, <run_dir>/bars/crypto

trade.target_rule: none (crypto: fixed 3xATR14 stop on the daily UTC close, no target)

signals.wave_end_reasons: zigzag: new extreme on lower volume (with-wave exhaustion); zigzag: against-wave volume > last with-wave; Weis: new extreme on lower volume (with-wave exhaustion); buying climax at swing high
signals.wave_start_reasons: Weis: against-wave exhaustion (lower volume on new extreme)

levelsfile.producer: scanner_levelsfile.build -> scanner_charts.build_levels (+ S/R on the same bars)
